velgroth_lucernia.name: Velgroth-Lucernia
velgroth_lucernia.government: High Kingship (multiple petty kingdoms under nominal High King)
velgroth_lucernia.recent_history: Past 50 years: No inter-kingdom warfare (unprecedented peace)

velgroth.status: Recovering seafaring tradition, exploring wild coasts
velgroth.exploration: Seeking other human settlements with no success

lucernia.history: Was Sparta-like but ardor has cooled, collectivist culture fading

imazuran_confederation.name: Imazuran Confederation
imazuran_confederation.government: Confederation of clan-kingdoms; each clan led by an Agellid; paramount Amghar elected by assembly for fixed term, non-consecutive
imazuran_confederation.current_amghar: Naravas (late 50s, mid-steppe clan; politically caught between border hawks demanding action to reclaim lost territories and cautious inland clans; publicly champions New Gods, privately maintains family bazina)

altava.status: Largest settlement; nearest to the assembly ground; closest thing to a political center without being a capital

madauros.status: Highland town; defensible; second most significant settlement

zarai.status: Market and waystation town on a reliable river crossing; trade hub

geography.character: Inland plateau and high plain, cut by seasonal rivers; dispersed population with wide open ground between settlements
geography.western_frontier: The Sebkha — dry salt flat belt separating Imazuran from the Luric Marches; hard to traverse but a road now runs through it (primary trade corridor west)
geography.borders: Humanoid-occupied or geographically forbidding on all sides; humanoids expanded from always-wild regions and now hold ancestral Imazuran lands

thagaste.status: Humanoid-occupied but not destroyed; ancestral home of Tafat's clan; formally held as a grievance-claim by the Confederation assembly; some original population may remain
thagaste.significance: Tafat (PC) was displaced from here; her clan is now landless, living on confederation hospitality, with a recognized claim

horse_culture.military: Light cavalry; riders control horses with leg pressure and voice, no saddle or bridle; finest mobile fighters in the region
horse_culture.social: Horses mark clan status; exchanged as bride-price and blood-price
horse_culture.funerary: Horses buried with important dead or sacrificed at burial; horse breeding and training closely guarded knowledge

religion.primary: New Gods (shared pantheon with Velgroth-Lucernia); at least one Irkali site within Imazuran territory — faith has indigenous legitimacy, not a western import
religion.ancestor_worship: Fading tradition displaced by New Gods; bazinas (low stone tumuli) and haouanet (rock-cut cliff tombs) dot the landscape; elder clans still observe old rites quietly; disturbing burial sites remains a serious transgression

trade.primary_route: West through the Sebkha into the Luric Marches (dangerous, expensive, invaluable)
trade.internal: Pastoral and settled communities exchange hides, wool, cattle, horses, cheese for grain, pottery, metalwork
trade.constraints: Effectively landlocked with hostile or forbidding borders on all sides; entirely dependent on the Sebkha road for outside trade

history.pre_silence: A prior Imazuran polity existed but its political structures were destroyed by the Silence and the Kindling War; clan and individual continuity survived but institutional memory did not
history.post_silence: Confederation formed by surviving clan-leaders as a pragmatic response to humanoid expansion; a new political structure, not a restoration of the old
history.recent: Humanoids pressing all borders; ancestral lands lost and remembered; Thagaste in the north occupied within living memory

relations.velgroth_lucernia: Cultural and diplomatic ties through shared pantheon; Ardanir order seeks to deepen unity between Gallaecian and Amazigh through shared faith
relations.luric_marches: Western neighbor; blurry frontier; the Sebkha road is the thread connecting them; Imazuran has permanent interest in Marches stability

luric_marches.name: The Luric Marches
luric_marches.location: Between civilized lands and wilderness, east of Lucernia, west of Imazuran

example_settlements: Caelrun (most residents unaware of lizard-man control)

irkali.name: The Five Irkali (Marhaz)
irkali.description: Sites where New Gods first manifested
